pages.text: I can leave a temporary luminous road beneath my feet.

$(bold)Mana:$() ⅛ bucket$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Instant$(br2)One cast activates the trail for sixty seconds. As I move, the runtime places a narrow Hard Light block directly beneath me when the position is replaceable. Each block is solid, luminous, produces no item, and removes itself after about thirty seconds.
